name: my-win-app
description: 现代化 Electron + Vue 3 + TypeScript 桌面应用
author: Your Name

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --build tsconfig.node.json && vite build && electron-builder build --dir
scripts.build:prod: tsc --noEmit && tsc --build tsconfig.node.json && vite build && electron-builder build --publish=never
scripts.build:portable: tsc --noEmit && tsc --build tsconfig.node.json && vite build && electron-builder build --publish=never --win=portable
scripts.electron:dev: node compile-main.js && concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5180 && electron ."
